sites.boundary: Acquire an exclusive Web Locks lock (or, without Web Locks, an IndexedDB lease across tabs) for one account, chain and stable namespace, or one exact call. Coordinate durable reservation, wallet handoff and canonical recovery across tabs; this request is browser coordination and never a wallet RPC.
Take this tab's own queue for a write action before claiming the cross-tab IndexedDB lease. Browser coordination only, never a wallet RPC.
Take the reviewed sequence's lock across windows (Web Locks, or the IndexedDB lease without them) around each compare-and-set of its saved journal. Browser coordination only, never a wallet RPC.
Create the wagmi submission boundary for each reviewed Relayr transaction.
Submit the exact target, calldata, and value after switching to its declared chain.
Create the wagmi EIP-712 signing boundary for a canonical ERC-2771 forward request.
Sign only the validated chain, canonical forwarder domain, nonce, request, and deadline.

Read only eth_call on a PublicClient with explicit Safe selectors, gas and response bounds, at latest or a caller-given block (the reviewed receipt block when verifying). Serves Safe deployment verification and the authority identity, nonce and approval reads. Never sign, send, or follow OffchainLookup URLs.
Read only a raw eth_call of the reviewed call, bounded by explicit gas and a return data limit, at latest or a caller-given block. Never sign, send, or follow OffchainLookup URLs.
Read only eth_blockNumber and an eth_simulateV1 of the reviewed call pinned to that block, bounded by an 8 second timeout. Never sign or send; the result only labels the fee route.

The WalletAdapter boundary: send exactly the reviewed target, calldata, value and gas from the connected account, naming the call's chain so viem refuses a wallet on another one. Reached only from sendReviewed after the core-minted confirmation.
The WalletAdapter boundary: sign the exact typed data from the connected account.
The WalletAdapter boundary: sign the exact message from the connected account.
The WalletAdapter boundary: send the exact calls as one wallet batch from the connected account on the named chain.

sendReviewed hands one step's reviewed bytes, with the simulated gas, to the WalletAdapter, inside submitReviewedContractWrite under the step's write hold and only after core's own confirmation for the model of the whole action.

signPrepared hands the WalletAdapter typed data core built from its own Safe, forwarder and Permit2 constants, inside submitReviewedContractWrite's account and chain checks, only after core's own confirmation for the model that shows that exact typed data.
signPrepared hands the WalletAdapter the exact message text the confirmed model shows, inside submitReviewedContractWrite's account check, only after core's own confirmation.
